correctness.rationale: For the normalized Hardy Laurent basis e_j=z^j/sqrt(1+r^(2j)), direct multiplication gives K_{m,n}e_j=F_{mh,nh}(jh)e_{j+n-m}, h=-2log r; the index shift is injective, so these coefficients give precisely all positive singular values. Differentiating log F, a sum of negatives of log-sum-exp terms, shows strict concavity with exponential tails. Every strict upper-level set is a single interval: integer-grid count differs from length/h by <=1, and layer-cake yields all-p Schatten-power discrepancy <=M^p (also p<1). Parameter-uniform exponential tails give simultaneous m h→a>0 and n h→b>0 limits and peak convergence. The stated rational/log H2 integral was independently checked against numerical integration for multiple unequal a,b; rational cross coefficients and symmetry exchange were checked. The diagonal a=b is a calibration, not claimed new.
